summary_list.suggested_action: Notify the module team to lock the rubric before release and inform students promptly of any changes; provide a clear addendum for the deadline.
Escalate the placement mismatch to the career office, request alignment with course objectives, and arrange alternative tasks that develop relevant skills.
Ask the tutor to streamline the session by removing duplicated examples and focus on new material to use tutorial time efficiently.

overall_summary: This summary covers 3 of 6 feedback entries received. Two high‑severity issues were reported: Assessment – rubric changed days before deadline, and Internship Placement – tasks limited to photocopying and data entry unrelated to the course. The only other concern, Teaching Quality (low severity), notes a tutorial that repeats the same example, wasting session time.
